No fixture of this record runs a framework or an oracle script: 0 fixtures call one of the 3 oracle scripts that are pinned as data. The 6 source modules import 0 packages and the Node built-ins fs, path. The 3 leaf descriptors state verificationBasis synthetic-only and 0 of their 12 capability flags are not false. Whether a leaf agrees with the runtime behaviour of Hono, Koa or Next.js is UNKNOWN.

The leaf descriptors state the legacy contract sbf.adapter/2 and a scan returns the keys apiSurfaceSource, filesRead, modules, scanNotes. Of the 6 source modules scanned for import specifiers, 0 import a contracts/next module and 0 build a specifier at run time. Output in the contracts/next form is UNSUPPORTED by this layer.
The package.json of the base commit lists 15 entries under files and 0 of them cover adapters/, so the T13 modules are outside the npm file list.

The registry entry points scanners/registry.mjs, scanners/index.mjs mention a T13 path or leaf id 0 times. 11 files outside the two track directories name one at the base commit (references lists them), 0 of them are shipped code, and 1 of them imports a T13 module (adapters/http-wave-a/python-scope/verify.mjs). profile-evidence.json states promotion_state HOLD_T19_T23.

profile-evidence.json cites CI run 36095053997 for the head 46bcff62731da3498cb9e7764e33cdfec83cc6ce; that head is the base commit: false, so the run is history and not a replay of this tree. The CI observation of this record is the push run 38075313210 of the base commit, read once from the GitHub API and not fetched again by the tests.

The 3 normal scan fixtures read directories whose SOURCE.md files (3 are pinned) name an upstream example as their source: 2 name a README.md and 1 name a docs page. The record does not compare these directories with upstream; it replays them as data.
41 fixtures run a leaf on a tree of files authored for this record. They show what a leaf returns for those texts; they are not a sample of real projects.

6 fixtures show source forms that a leaf does not emit: 6 of them carry a scan note that the upstream-example scan of the same leaf does not carry, and the endpoints they emit together number 1. A withheld form is UNKNOWN to a consumer, not absent.

Unknown and withheld information is reported as free text in scanNotes. Across the 41 scan fixtures the endpoint keys are line, method, operationId, params, path, routeName, verb, and 4 distinct reason codes appear inside note texts (listed in the facts).

In 6 fixtures a route form is lost without a note: 0 of the scans carry a note that the upstream-example scan of the same leaf does not carry, and the endpoints they emit are (paths per fixture) no path; /a; no path; /a; /api; /api. For these inputs the output does not let a consumer tell a dropped route from a route that does not exist.

In 2 fixtures a route is emitted under the path of its own router and without the prefix of a mount that the leaf could not resolve (emitted paths /list; /c). 2 of the scans carry a scan note about the mount (extra_note_texts in the facts), but a note is not attached to an endpoint, so the endpoint alone looks final.
